messages:
carmen: Noticing spikes on auth-gateway 503s in us-central during today's canary, ~12% of requests failing. Pausing release until we triage. @evan are you available?

deploybot: deploybot update: Release 2340 -> PAUSED by user carmen. Reason: auth-gateway 503s. To resume: `deploybot resume --release 2340`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-355 (auth-gateway us-central). Oncall paged: @evan. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-355

ev an: (oncall) on it. quick glance: gateway upstreams returning 502->503 after a small spike in concurrent JWT validations. No DB errors.

tess: thanks. do we want a rollback to v2.0.1 (previous) or pin and investigate? rolling back removes the new auth header optimization.

raj: preference = pin + short investigation. rollback is nuclear unless user-facing errors grow.

carmen: agree pin+triage. I'll pin in Release Conductor: `release-manager pin 2340 --reason \"INC-2026-355 auth-gateway 503s\"`. Also set a contingency change window for tomorrow 09:00 PT.

release-manager: Pin applied: 2340. State: PINNED (reason: INC-2026-355). To unpin: `release-manager unpin 2340 --by <owner>`

ops-bot: Change window created: 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC (contingency). Notifications sent to eng + cs.

ev an: small mitigation I'm going to toggle `auth-token-cache` to 30s on canary hosts, and reduce validation concurrency from 50->20. Will patch config now and report in 7m.

tess: I'll update the release notes and add a brief internal note: "paused - investigating auth-gateway 503s; pinned to prevent accidental resume."

deploybot: Reminder: deploybot will not auto-rollback. Manual rollback: `deploybot rollback --release 2340 --to v2.0.1`

ev an: config change applied. initial metrics: 503s dropped to 3.4% from 12% on canary. latency unaffected.

carmen: good. let's hold 20m and re-evaluate. if under 2% consider resuming a constrained canary (10% for 10m). @deploybot confirm hold timer.

deploybot: Confirmed: release 2340 status = PAUSED. Next auto-check: +20m. Alerts hooked to #slo-alerts.

ops-bot: Incident page updated with mitigation steps; added link to config rollback playbook.

tess: customer-facing blurb drafted: "Release paused due to transient auth-gateway errors; no user data impacted. We'll update in ~30 minutes."

ev an: 20m update: canary 503s now ~1.6%. I'm comfortable to resume a limited canary. propose `deploybot resume --release 2340 --canary 10% --stages 10m`.

carmen: proceed. runbook: if errors spike >5% in next 15m, abort and rollback considered.

deploybot: Command received. Resuming release 2340 with canary 10% for 10m. Monitoring channels: #slo-alerts, #eng-oncall.

tess: documenting timeline and next steps; will convert incident into an RCA stub and assign to evan + infra-team.

raj: note for postmortem: check JWT validation library upgrade and concurrency handling in canary vs prod.

carmen: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as canonical. reopening if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
_meta: generated for dataset: incident-triggered release hold and rescheduling
